items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: And I heard Hilton Jefferson and Elmore Williams, the tenor player that wind up with Chick. But that was way before.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

fine teacher. A very fine teacher. He was very fine. And I studied with him for quite a while. I forgotten how many years I studied with him.. It was during the time I was going to school. And we used to study on a Sunday and maybe twice a week. He was very strict. He gave you to do after you came in. things (inaudible) And he turned me out. (Inaudible) became a very outstanding tenor player, but I didn't play much around Philly when I was kid. I was young, in my 20's or something like that. I didn't play much…
